title: ComponentShareIntentRequest
description: POST /service/v1/component-directory/bindings/{bindingId}/share-intents (DD-164(4)②): the component service names the native object its user wants to share. Only sent when the initiator may share the object natively; grants nothing.

nativeId.description: 1-255 visible characters: Cells node UUID or WeKnora knowledge base ID.

workspaceId.description: The Kailo Workspace whose root contains the object, absent for Tenant-level objects.
